updates.reason: The corpus now has distinct actual LDraw cave grammars: enclosed Wampa cave, a separate multi-level The Cave submodel, a narrow rocky Shelob lair, coastal rock-island cavities, and a rough hideout threshold.
updates.next: Run local dependency resolution and extract aperture/chamber/shelf/blocked-threshold metrics. Assign different cave ancestors to Cyclops, Ogygia, Nymph Cave and Cimmerian scenes rather than reusing one cave.

updates.reason: A public custom Hagia Sophia LDraw corpus provides a 3,951-placement tested construction with official-part geometry, large arches, buttresses, narthex and dome-support systems. It is not Bronze-Age Greek and remains an architectural morphology donor only.
updates.next: Review source license before derived-geometry redistribution; extract arches/columned entry/masonry shell only where they solve a Halfworld spatial requirement.
